findings.location: Paragraph 3 (the paragraph that begins “Several hours later, as he pushed wearily onward…” in source.html)
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the Indonesian phrase that renders this as “tersandung pada seutas akar” with wording that accurately reflects a vine (a climbing/twining plant). For example: “tersandung pada seutas sulur” or “tersandung pada seutas tanaman merambat.” Preserve the surrounding HTML and punctuation when making the change.
findings.translation_quote: Tiba-tiba, karena tidak dapat melihat jalan dengan jelas dalam kegelapan hutan, Beto tersandung pada seutas akar dan terjerembab tak berdaya ke tanah.
